name: Notary / Law Firm (AMLR obliged)
description: Notaries and law firms acting in real estate transactions, company formation, trust services or client-money management. AMLR-obliged when undertaking the relevant activities. Focus: client identification, source of funds, beneficial ownership, client account flows.

recommends_fcp_domains.rationale: Mandatory — AMLR-obliged when conducting real estate, company formation, trust or client-money work.
Client + UBO screening; nominee / front-entity exposure.
